stories.title: Zelensky says Crimean Bridge strikes 'fair response' as he meets UK's Streeting
stories.body: Ukraine's president says Kyiv acted after 109 separate Russian aerial attacks on bridges in Ukraine.

stories.title: Russia-bound ship attacked in Gulf of Finland
stories.body: Finnish defence forces say that Ukraine was likely behind the drone attack on the vessel.

stories.title: Fight over fossil fuels leaves COP31 climate talks in deadlock
stories.body: Countries from nearly 200 countries are in a deadlock to try and get a new global climate agreement.

stories.title: Mexican drug lord on FBI's 10 most wanted list arrested in shoot-out
stories.body: Fausto Isidro "Chapo Idisro" Meza Flores, who is accused of drug trafficking and torture, is detained after gun fight with authorities.

stories.title: FBI reportedly investigating apparent hack of its criminal database
stories.body: The National Crime Information Center database is used by federal and local law enforcement to share information.

stories.title: Denmark accuses Russia of plotting to assassinate US-Ukrainian rapper
stories.body: The Russian embassy in Denmark has denied the allegation, which has led to Russia's defence attaché being expelled.

stories.title: Man convicted of starting Palisades fire in Los Angeles
stories.body: The 30-year-old LA resident was convicted of arson leading to wildfires that killed 12 people and destroyed more than 6,800 buildings.

stories.title: Lock of former US President George Washington's hair sells for $4,000
stories.body: The hair was given as a sign of friendship shortly before Washington's death in 1799, according to a descendent of its former owner.

stories.title: Deal with EU not dependent on tuition fees agreement, Miliband says
stories.body: Brussels sources had previously suggested the bloc might not apply the wider deal until fees were lowered for EU students in Britain.

stories.title: French police officers sentenced for beating of music producer Michel Zecler
stories.body: The court has upheld the 2020 beating of the black music producer as an aggravated circumstance of racism.

stories.title: Tech stock sell-off drags markets down as Anthropic shares slide
stories.body: Pressures weighed on US markets, with the S&P 500 and the Dow Jones Industrial Average pushed into correction territory.

stories.title: In a year of AI solving maths problems, an Anthropic worker says he may have cracked the biggest
stories.body: A mathematician at Anthropic says he used an AI to prove the famed Riemann hypothesis, though verification will take some time.

stories.title: Mamdani announces plan to close New York's Rikers Island jail by 2032
stories.body: Plans to shutter the troubled facility date back to 2019, when the city council first voted to close it but delays arose over where to place inmates.

stories.title: Trafalgar Square Christmas tree felled in Norway
stories.body: The 21m tree is Oslo’s annual thank you for Britain’s support during World War Two.

stories.title: Zelensky says Putin is a 'killer' after Trump calls Russian leader a friend
stories.body: Earlier this week, Trump greeted Putin ahead of a meeting in China and said the pair have a "great relationship".

stories.title: Trump threatens ban on US firms building AI data centres overseas
stories.body: The US president provided little detail on the potential policy, saying others in his team were hearing about it for the first time.

stories.title: Indian man sentenced to 19-plus years in plot to assassinate US-based Sikh separatist leader
stories.body: Nikhil Gupta pleaded guilty to murder-for-hire, conspiracy to commit murder-for-hire, and conspiracy to commit money laundering in February.

stories.title: US declassifies more UFO footage filmed in the Middle East
stories.body: The Pentagon has released an eighth tranche of UFO records, which includes three video clips recorded in 2020, 2023 and 2026.

stories.title: Miami or Vice City? Tour the real-world inspiration for GTA 6
stories.body: BBC News Mundo’s Rafael Rojas visits the real-life Miami locations that inspired Vice City, GTA 6’s fictionalised setting.

stories.title: What the new UK-EU deal could mean for future post-Brexit relations
stories.body: The BBC's political and Europe editors analyse the new agreements between the UK and EU.
